The minimum number of weights needed to measure any integral weight from 1 to 40 kilograms on a balance scale, where weights can only be placed on one side, is 6. This can be achieved by using weights of 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32 kilograms. These weights can be combined in various ways to measure any weight from 1 to 40 kilograms. For example, to measure 3 kilograms, you would use the 1 and 2 kilogram weights; to measure 10 kilograms, you would use the 1, 2, and 7 kilogram weights (where 7 is the sum of 1, 2, and 4). The problem is well-defined, and the solution is unique and objectively verifiable.
